metadata.derivation: Derived by SpektraLab from fujifilm_provia_100f (dyes and structure): Polaroid Corporation T-600 film family datasheet (ISO 640, daylight 5500 K, normal development at 21 C); original Polaroid Corp. chemistry, not the current Polaroid B.V. film. Instant print approximated as a directly scanned positive: characteristic curves (reflection density read as transmission density, unmixed with the base dyes) and spectral sensitivity digitized from the manufacturer datasheet; print white tint from the datasheet minimum densities; hanatos2025 adaptation data are the base's.
